review_locator: PMCID:PMC6662913, Transcriptional regulation of CD4+ TH cells that mediate tissue inflammation; PMCID:PMC6981297, Epigenetic and transcriptional mechanisms for the regulation of IL-10
primary_title: RBPJ Controls Development of Pathogenic Th17 Cells by Regulating IL-23 Receptor Expression
decision_basis: The reviews identify RBPJ as a direct enhancer of IL-23R expression in pathogenic Th17 cells; the cited primary demonstrates RBPJ occupancy at the Il23r promoter, promoter transactivation in reporter assays, RBPJ-deficient loss of IL-23R expression and cooperation with RORgammaT.
limitations_preserved: Direct RBPJ promoter occupancy and transactivation support gene activation in the tested Th17 context; the edge does not by itself establish NICD occupancy, IL-23R protein trafficking, SCI relevance, or terminal-TF output.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6981297, Epigenetic and transcriptional mechanisms for the regulation of IL-10; PMCID:PMC6662913, Transcriptional regulation of CD4+ TH cells that mediate tissue inflammation
primary_title: RBPJ Controls Development of Pathogenic Th17 Cells by Regulating IL-23 Receptor Expression
decision_basis: The reviews identify RBPJ as a repressor of IL-10 expression in pathogenic Th17 cells; the cited primary demonstrates increased IL-10 production after RBPJ deficiency and RBPJ-dependent repression of c-Maf-induced Il10 transcription, with promoter/regulatory-region mechanistic assays.
limitations_preserved: Primary data support bounded RBPJ-associated Il10 gene repression in Th17 cells; RBPJ can act as repressor or coactivator depending on NICD/Notch state, so no universal IL-10 suppression, protein-secretion, SCI, or terminal-TF inference is made.
